verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Dagster exposing itself as an MCP server (Dagster+ MCP server, dagster-docs-14/probe-3) so external AI agents can call Dagster's tools — the opposite direction of the story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Dagster so Dagster can use their tools. No evidence shows Dagster acting as an MCP client consuming other servers' tools.
